items.raw_excerpt: The woman had originally been allowed to work from home two days a week to help her recovery but was suddenly told she had to work at the campus five days a week and that her medical documentation was inadequate.
items.summary_en: A woman was allowed to work from home two days a week to help her recovery. She was suddenly told to work at the school campus five days a week and that her medical documents were not enough. She resigned and later won S$20,000 in a legal case.
items.summary_ko: 이 여성은 회복을 돕기 위해 주 2일 재택근무를 허락받았지만, 갑자기 주 5일 모두 학교에 출근해야 한다며 의료 서류가 충분하지 않다는 통보를 받았습니다. 결국 사직했고, 법적 다툼 끝에 2만 싱가포르 달러 배상을 받았습니다.
items.title_en: Cancer survivor wins $20,000 after being forced to resign over work-from-home dispute

items.title_original: Cancer survivor forced to resign from school after tussles over work-from-home arrangements wins S$20,000

items.raw_excerpt: Foreign residents' language skills are in the news again following a Munich cafe's social media post defending its staff for speaking English. We want to hear your experience of learning German and whether you think German is essential to live here.
items.summary_en: A cafe in Munich defended its staff for speaking English on social media. This has started a new debate about foreign residents' language skills. We want to hear your experience learning German and whether fluent German is needed to live here.

items.raw_excerpt: The measures are part of the transport authority's operational and financial plans for the years 2027-2029, with a decision on the proposals coming later this year.
items.summary_en: Helsinki's regional transport operator HSL plans to raise the fine for riding without a ticket to 130 euros. It also wants to increase ticket prices. The changes are part of its plans for 2027 to 2029, and a final decision comes later this year.
items.summary_ko: 헬싱키 수도권 대중교통을 운영하는 HSL이 무임승차 벌금을 130유로로 올리고 요금도 인상할 계획입니다. 이는 2027~2029년 운영 및 재정 계획의 일부로, 최종 결정은 올해 안에 내려질 예정입니다.
items.title_en: Helsinki transport HSL wants to raise penalty fines to 130 euros and raise fares

items.title_original: HSL wants to increase penalty fines to 130 euros, fare increases also in pipeline

items.raw_excerpt: Tickets for the Lions' home match against Thailand were snapped up almost as soon as they became available.
items.summary_en: Tickets for the Singapore national team's home match against Thailand were sold out almost right away. Many fans are disappointed. Some scalpers are now reselling the tickets at higher prices.

items.raw_excerpt: Counting down the seconds until the weekend, or fancy a midweek beer? Just as well it's 'little Saturday'.
items.summary_en: In Norway, Wednesday is called Lille lørdag, which means little Saturday. People count down the seconds to the weekend or enjoy a midweek beer. It is a small Norwegian tradition to celebrate the middle of the week.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이에서는 수요일을 '릴레 뢰르다그'라고 부르는데, '작은 토요일'이라는 뜻입니다. 주말을 손꼽아 기다리거나 한 주 중간에 맥주 한 잔을 즐기기에 좋은 날로 여깁니다. 한 주의 한가운데를 작게 축하하는 노르웨이만의 문화입니다.
items.title_ko: 노르웨이 표현 소개: 릴레 뢰르다그(작은 토요일)
items.title_original: Norwegian expression of the day: Lille lørdag

items.raw_excerpt: Cyclists from Mysuru bagged three silver and one bronze in addition to three gold medals across Individual Time Trial (ITT) and Mass Start events during the championship.
items.summary_en: Cyclists from Mysuru district won seven medals at the Karnataka championship. They took three gold, three silver, and one bronze. The medals came from time trial and mass start events.

items.title_original: Seven medals for cyclists from Mysuru district at Karnataka championship
